hero.title: Working together for Wybourn
hero.paragraph_1: The hub works with trusted local organisations to deliver activities, support, advice, and opportunities for local residents.
hero.paragraph_2: If your organisation would like to run a session, host an event, or explore partnership working, email the hub and we will be happy to talk.
hero.card_text: We work with partners who help us create welcoming spaces, practical support, and opportunities for people of all ages.

partners.title: Great Places Housing Group
partners.description: Great Places helped bring the Pat Midgley Community Hub to life and continues to support activity, services, and opportunities in Wybourn.

partners.title: Manor & Castle Development Trust
partners.description: From digital support to advice sessions and breakfast drop-ins, Manor & Castle Development Trust helps residents access practical day-to-day support.

partners.title: MASKK
partners.description: MASKK helps deliver youth activities and safe spaces for children and young people to connect, play, and build confidence.

partners.title: Chatty Cafe Scheme
partners.description: Chatty Cafe sessions help create warm, welcoming opportunities for conversation, connection, and community each week.

callout.title: Interested in partnering with the hub?
callout.text: Email pmcommunityhub@outlook.com with your idea, event, or service and we will get back to you.
